conflict_resolutions.EVENT_QUOTE_NOT_VERIFIED_AGAINST_HELD_RA: The flag concerns an event quote taken from the OFR catalog record (Revoked by: EO 14154, January 20, 2025) that could not be matched to the held raw API record. The status here does not rest on that quote or on the catalog: it rests on the held Federal Register text of EO 14154 (90 FR 8353), Section 4(a)(x), which names EO 14072 of April 22, 2022 among the revoked orders, read directly in ACT:EO:14072>EO:14154.

notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
rationale: EO 14072 (April 22, 2022, Strengthening the Nation's Forests, Communities, and Local Economies) is revoked in full by EO 14154 (signed Jan. 20, 2025; 90 FR 8353, Jan. 29, 2025), Sec. 4(a), which states that the listed orders are revoked and any offices established therein are abolished and lists at item (x) Executive Order 14072 of April 22, 2022. The order has no own-terms end for the whole order and no earlier order revokes it. Partial scope: the revocation names EO 14072 in full; EO 14154 Sec. 4(b) separately addresses activities taken under revoked orders, which is a direction to agencies, not a continuation of EO 14072. Savings: no continuing command of EO 14072 is preserved. The status is no as of 2026-10-14; EO 14154 is the formal disposition and a bound, not the first end of each of 31 clauses.
